name: cart-recomposed
description: Checkout §5.2's hard case: two lessons at R$ 100 are ordered and confirmed; the customer swaps them for one consultation at R$ 200 and asks to pay. The order's single item (the customer, R$ 200,00, due today) and its items_hash are IDENTICAL before and after; only the cart_hash (the composition bound to the execution and the artifact, checkout §9.7) differs, and it is what sends the order back to the attendant. One charge, for the consultation.
